auth.signInDescription: Sign in to access your repositories.
auth.invitedAccountSeparator: or sign in with an invited account
auth.privacyNote: By signing in, you agree to our terms of service and privacy policy.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your account and application preferences.
settings.signOutDescription: Sign out of your account on this device.

aiProvider.title: AI Provider
aiProvider.description: Choose the AI provider and enter your API key. Your key is encrypted at rest and never shared.

providerDescriptions.lmstudio: Run models locally — free, private, no API key needed.
providerDescriptions.anthropic: Use Claude models directly via the Anthropic API.
providerDescriptions.openai: Use GPT models via the OpenAI API.
providerDescriptions.openrouter: Access models from multiple providers through a single API key.

aiProvider.lmstudioNote: Using LM Studio at localhost:1234 — no API key required. Make sure the server is running with your chat model loaded.
aiProvider.chatModelHint: Used in the Chat tab for answering questions about your code.
aiProvider.mindmapModelHint: Used when indexing a repository to generate the mind map and wiki pages.
aiProvider.noModelsFound: No models found. Make sure LM Studio is running and the server is started.
aiProvider.embeddingModelHint: Used for generating code chunk embeddings during repository indexing.
aiProvider.connectionError: Unable to connect to LM Studio. Is it running?
aiProvider.embeddingWarningBody: Changing your embedding model may affect search quality for previously indexed repositories. You can re-index repositories from their settings page to use the new model.

home.title: ConvergeKit
home.headline: Bring product intent, code reality, and agent context together.
home.subheadline: ConvergeKit turns repositories into a shared evidence layer so product teams, engineers, and AI agents can work from the same understanding.
home.feature1Desc: Stop relying on memory. Ask what the product does, see the evidence.
home.feature2Desc: Read the wiki, ask the chat, follow citations back to the file that proves it.
home.feature3Desc: MCP tokens give Claude Desktop, Cursor, and CI agents identical scope.
home.workflow1Desc: Clone, parse, embed. Mind-map the architecture into evidence tiers.
home.workflow2Desc: Chat or read the wiki. Every answer carries its sources.
home.workflow3Desc: Engineers and agents see the same evidence. No two stories about the same code.

docs.indexingDescription: This may take a few minutes depending on repository size.
docs.indexingStalled: Taking longer than expected — the worker may be busy or restarting. This page will update automatically.
docs.indexingFailedDescription: An error occurred during indexing. Please try again from Settings.
docs.selectDocument: Select a file from the tree to view its content.
docs.indexingComplete: Repository indexed successfully. Files are ready.
docs.wikiRegenerationInProgress: Wiki regeneration is running in the background.
docs.wikiRegenerationProgress: Progress: {progress}%. Your indexed documents remain available while the wiki updates.
docs.wikiRegenerationStalled: Wiki regeneration is taking longer than expected.
docs.wikiRegenerationStalledDescription: The repository is still indexed. You can keep browsing documents while the wiki job retries or catches up.
docs.wikiRegenerationFailedDescription: The repository is still indexed. Retry wiki generation from Settings instead of reindexing the whole repository.
docs.wikiRegenerationCompleteDescription: The repository stayed available the whole time, and the wiki content has been refreshed.

structure.description: Browse the file and directory structure of the indexed repository.

repoGuide.headline: What ConvergeKit knows about this repo
repoGuide.headlineDescription: Use this guide to understand the indexed knowledge and phrase questions so answers come from the strongest evidence.
repoGuide.coverageDescription: A high-level map of where ConvergeKit has strong, partial, or gated evidence.
repoGuide.preparingDescription: ConvergeKit is indexing evidence for this repository. Answer quality may improve when indexing completes.
repoGuide.metadataRefreshing: Metadata still being refreshed. This guide is using path-based classification until the evidence backfill completes.
repoGuide.computingAreasDescription: These temporary areas use top-level paths and will be replaced by the repo mind map when it is ready.
repoGuide.tip: "Show me where this is implemented" pulls current code. "Why was this designed this way?" opens design/history evidence after checking current code.
repoGuide.advancedSettingsHint: For advanced users, MCP setup and repository controls live in Advanced Settings.

chat.title: Chat with your codebase
chat.description: Ask questions about the repository and get AI-powered answers.
chat.sessionError: Failed to start chat session. Please refresh.
chat.messageError: Failed to send message. Please try again.
chat.responseInterrupted: The response stopped before the final answer. Please try again.

settings.mcpTokensDescription: Create tokens to connect AI tools (Claude Desktop, Cursor) to this repository via the MCP protocol.
settings.tokenOnce: Copy it now — it will not be shown again.
settings.noTokens: No tokens yet. Create one to connect your AI tools.
settings.reindexDescription: Clear all indexed data and regenerate documents, mind map, and wiki pages from scratch.
settings.regenerateWikiDescription: Rebuild all wiki pages from the existing index. Faster than re-indexing — use this when wiki content looks wrong or truncated.
settings.deleteRepositoryDescription: Permanently delete this repository and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
settings.deleteRepositoryConfirmBody: All branches, documents, wiki pages, and chat history will be permanently removed.

repositories.emptyDescription: Connect your first repository to start generating AI-powered documentation.
repositories.emptyAssignedDescription: Your ConvergeKit account is active, but an admin needs to assign you to a group before repositories appear here.
repositories.name: Name

wiki.generatingDescription: AI is writing wiki pages for this repository. This may take a few minutes.
wiki.noWikiDescription: Wiki pages are generated automatically after indexing completes. Re-index the repository to trigger generation.
